Macro recovery and some homicide improvement are real but only partly attributable and coexist with unfinished reforms (E001, E105). Congressional defeat of the electricity reform and continuing judicial review show meaningful resistance, while the Ayotzinapa process shows some accountability response but incomplete proof of remedy (E022, E023, E029).
